desc: Task 1 (math/derivation): marginal-cost model `(2k−1)P_i`, threshold formulation `k_i(x)=((x//P_i)+1)//2`, tie-handling `ans = g(x*) + min(c, (M−f(x*))//(x*+1))`.

Task 2 (full implementation): fast I/O, `np.unique` compression, overflow-safe `evaluate(x)` (clipped squaring, `t > M//P` feasibility test, 2^30 high/low exact summation), binary search with hi = 2·10^14, leftover-unit count `c`, output.

Task 3 (correctness validation): sample 1 traced (→3); sample 2 traced by hand (x*=37, cost 998, units 53, price 38, c=2, extra 0 → 53 ✓); edge cases N=1/P=2e9/M=1 → 0, all P_i=1 verified; clipping proven never to yield a false "feasible" since (10^9+1)² > 10^18 ≥ M//P.
Task 4 (performance): ~48 iterations × a few vectorized ops over ≤2·10^5 (deduplicated) elements; partial sums bounded by ~2·10^14, well within int64.
